policies.title: Enterprise Risk Management Policy
policies.description: Board-approved policy establishing the risk governance framework, appetite-setting process and three-lines-of-defence model.

policies.title: Risk Appetite Statement
policies.description: Per-category residual risk thresholds approved by the Board, driving escalation triggers in the risk module.

policies.title: Code of Conduct & Personal Trading Policy
policies.description: Employee conduct standards, personal trading pre-clearance, restricted list and insider trading prevention.

policies.title: Valuation Policy
policies.description: Security valuation methodology including illiquid debt dual-source verification and override authorization.

policies.title: Investment Restrictions Standard
policies.description: Internal investment restriction limits supplementing SEBI regulatory limits per scheme category.

policies.title: Information Security Policy
policies.description: Umbrella information and cyber security policy aligned to the SEBI Cyber Security & Cyber Resilience Framework.

policies.title: Outsourcing & Vendor Management Policy
policies.description: Due diligence, contracting, SLA oversight and exit management for material outsourced service providers.

policies.title: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery Policy
policies.description: Continuity governance, BIA methodology, recovery objectives and exercise cadence.

policies.title: NAV Error Handling Procedure
policies.description: Step-by-step procedure for NAV error identification, recomputation, compensation and regulatory reporting.

policies.title: Incident Response Procedure
policies.description: Incident intake, severity classification, containment, CERT-In 6-hour reporting step and post-incident review.

policies.title: Data Privacy Policy (DPDP)
policies.description: Investor personal data handling standards under the DPDP Act — consent, purpose limitation, breach notification and data principal rights.

policies.title: Social Media Usage Guideline
policies.description: Guidance for employees on social media use, including scheme performance discussion restrictions.

policyVersions.title: Valuation Policy v5.0

policyVersions.changeSummary: Added CERT-In 6-hour reporting step and log retention extension per regulatory change RCH-2026-0002.

policyVersions.title: Data Privacy Policy v1.0 (draft)
policyVersions.changeSummary: Initial DPDP-aligned privacy policy — consent framework, breach notification and rights handling.

policyVersions.title: Social Media Usage Guideline v1.1 (draft)
policyVersions.changeSummary: Extends coverage to short-video platforms and clarifies performance-claim restrictions.

policyExceptions.title: Valuation policy deviation during vendor feed outage
policyExceptions.description: During the April price-feed outage, fallback valuations deviated from the documented waterfall for 2 securities.
policyExceptions.remediationPlan: Waterfall amended in v5.0 to cover feed outage scenario; deviation memo filed with Trustees.
